blurb: Stockfish 11 is the January 2020 release of Stockfish and the final major release built exclusively on its classical hand-crafted evaluation before NNUE arrived in Stockfish 12. Developed through Fishtest distributed SPRT testing, it pairs magic bitboards, aggressive LMR, singular extensions, ProbCut, and continuation and capture histories with a deeply tuned classical evaluator. Adapted to UCI over WASI from the pinned sf_11 commit.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build (Threads fixed to 1); no Syzygy tablebases (no filesystem in WASI).

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: Plain 64-bit magic bitboards for sliding-piece attack generation.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Null-window searches after the first move with full-window re-searches on fail-high.

features.label: Aspiration Windows
features.implementation: Narrow root window from depth 4 with asymmetric widening on fail-high or fail-low.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Dynamic reduction scaled by depth and static eval margin over beta, with verification search at high depth.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Logarithmic reduction table adjusted by PV, improving flag, cut-node status, and move history.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: TT-move exclusion search extending singular moves alongside multi-cut and negative extensions.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Shallow reduced search on SEE-passing captures to prune clear beta cutoffs early.

features.label: Continuation History
features.implementation: Gravity-updated butterfly table plus 1-, 2-, and 4-ply piece-to continuation histories.

features.label: Capture History
features.implementation: Piece-to-captured history table guiding tactical move ordering and capture pruning.

features.label: Tapered Eval
features.implementation: Packed middlegame/endgame score pairs with material imbalance, mobility, space, initiative, and lazy evaluation.

features.label: King Zone Attack
features.implementation: Weighted piece attacks, safe checks, and pawn shelter/storm combined nonlinearly into king danger.
